Dialog: (The scene opens up showing a sky view of the backyard).

Name: Game Announcer
Dialog: Get ready! Round 1! Fight!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Laughs) You're mine, meat!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? You want a piece of me?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh uh, I want the whole thing, baby.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So, what are you young ladies doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wrestling, Mom. Favorite game.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, I'll just be running a few errands. First, I'll get the groceries, then to the florist, and then to the car wash.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, whatever. Kinda busy right now.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Call if there's any trouble.

Name: Candace
Dialog: With my brothers, might as well call now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Huh. You're right, Ferb. I guess it would make a sound. Say, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There you are, Agent P. It has come to our attention that all pigeons have left the Downtown area. Of course, on the upside, I haven't washed my car in weeks. (Clears throat) We can, uh, only assume that Dr. Doofenshmirtz is involved. You know your mission.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That about does it.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys! Whatcha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We remodeled our old tree house. What do you think?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh my gosh! Wow.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, check it out! This is the main crib.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sweet!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's take the tube to the top.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Tube?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure. It's the fastest way up.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Are you sure about this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Relax. We haven't missed yet.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. You're our first passenger.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (Screams while zooming through the life ring tube. Finally, she lands at the top) Awesome.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let 'er rip.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Ah! (The boys land on Isabella with a thud and everyone laughs about it)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check out the view. Pretty sweet, huh?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No doubt. What's that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's just Candace's old tree-house. (Shows old tree-house) She doesn't use it anymore.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's just sad.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, what if we gave it a makeover?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Sure! Something more...well, I don't know...Candace!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very effective, don't you think, Perry the Platypus? (Sips drink, then spits it out upon realizing Perry is here) Perry the Platypus?! (at some pigeons) Get him! Stop him! He's headed for that clearly marked exit!

Name: Game Announcer
Dialog: Winner! Winner!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls as she throws her controller down)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Attention, Candace! Come out to the backyard! We have a surprise for you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's going on now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. Check out your old tree house. I think you're gonna like it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps; camera shows a newly remodeled tree house) No way! I better call Mom.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, don't be such a fuddy-duddy, Candy. Come on, let's check it out!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Tire swing lowers) I don't know, Stacy. I think they're up to some-- (tire swing lifts the girls up) Whoa! This is so weird. I can't believe it's my old tree house. Carpets, furniture, entertainment center. I mean, look at all the bells and whistles. (She says as they walk past literal bells and whistles. Ha! Puns!) Maybe my brothers have been replaced by aliens.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, and now they're gonna fatten you up so they can eat ya!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (As they enter the elevator) I can't believe they did this all for me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (On speaker) You may begin bouncing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bounce?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Laughs) Come on! Bounce!

Name: Both
Dialog: Woo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you think of your new tree house?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I love it! You thought of everything.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It gets better. Try pressing the THF button.

Name: Candace
Dialog: THF? What's that? Some sort of sound system? (Stacy presses a red button, reading "THF". The tree house slowly transforms into a robot) Uh, Phineas? What does THF stand for?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Tree House Fight!!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Laughs) This is so rad!

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: Oh snap! (Phineas and Ferb's treehouse transforms as well)

Name: Tree house
Dialog: I'm takin' you down!

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: AAAAAH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, Perry the Platypus, you are no match for my pigeons. I have conditioned their tiny, little bird brains to do exactly what I say, by using my brand new very evil invention called

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, hey. How's it goin'?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Observe! With this, I can implant the target image on their tiny, little brains in a flash! (Zaps the machine at the pigeon, making it lose its feathers) It-- It works better from a distance. Anyway, today at Town Hall, they will award the key to the city to My-Goody-Two-Shoes-Brother Roger. Oh, how I loathe him.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I like Uncle Roger.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you, Vanessa, but I don't believe I was talking to you. Is your name Perry the Platypus? No, I don't think so.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Sighs) I so should have gone to summer school.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I will not be attending the ceremony, but my pigeons will be there to rain on his parade! (Laughs) You see, Perry the Platypus, my brother Roger is at the top of a very long list of people I despise. (At Vanessa) Vanessa, music please.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You see, you see how I held that last note, good, huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Tree house fight!

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: Bring it on, maggots!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: (As Isabella holds up a Round 1 sign) Whoo! Awesome! Yeah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now what?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Look! The controls are just like the video game! Let's show 'em our mad skills. Woo-hoo! Let's dance, dweebs! (They wrestle)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, stop leading!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You stop leading. (They pass through an old man's garden; the old man sees them and assumes it was the Super Grow Plant Food) Give him the twister!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Right! (Throws Phineas and Ferb in the air)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Score!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hit the crash button! (Ferb does so, and they get covered in tires and brace themselves for the crash, and they land by one of the downtown buildings)

Name: Candace
Dialog: YES!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Woo! Well done, Candirocks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's nail 'em!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb. (Dressed as a pirate) The enemy is upon us! Man the cannons! (Cannon comes out with Ferb wearing a blue hat) FIRE! (Cannon fires)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-oh. Yow! What now?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Try pulling some levers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yipe! (Pulls a lever causing the pink robot's mouth to open and purple water balloons to fire)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb wearing Army outfits) Incoming! (He and Ferb get hit by the purple water balloons)

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: Yeah!  (The yellow robot's mouth opens to reveal water with a lifeboat, an oar and a couple of fish to come out) Ew!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (wearing knight's armor) Egad, man! It's an end run around the middle! (Ferb's revealed to be wearing a Scottish outfit) Sound retreat!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (salutes and plays the bagpipes)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. That's funny. I haven't gotten the usual call from Candace. (Get her phone out and calls her)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come and get me! (Sticks its bottom out releasing a horse and runs; Candace's cell phone rings)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (On phone) Candace, honey, I'm at the car-wash, and I'll be heading home very soon. Bye bye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no! (Can phone drops down)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb to Robo-Girls; (he and Ferb are wearing chicken costumes) Last one home is a big old purple pickled egg!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Imitates chicken clucking noise)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, the award ceremony. And there's my insipid brother Roger. (the tower viewer goes out) What? Oh, let's see if I've got another coin. Now, what was I saying-- Oh! I despise him so much. You are about to witness a truly petty act of vengeance, Perry the Platypus, brought on by my own mindless jealously. (At Vanessa) Vanessa, fire the harpoon! (Vanessa shoots the harpoon) Perfect. The time has come! Do not fail me, my pigeons! (The pigeons walk out on the rope in a line)

Name: Roger
Dialog: Ladies and Gentlemen, as the most handsome and charming man in all the Tri-State Area, I hereby promise to keep our city clean.

Name: Crowd
Dialog: (Applause and cheering)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pay attention and learn something, Perry the Platypu-- Wait, wait! Where's Perry the Platypus? He's escaping, with the Poop-inator!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Whoa! (They start to roll home with Agent P in tow)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Uh oh. This is not going to end well for me, I'm afraid.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: That's what you get for using a bunch of stupid pigeons.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait for me! (runs with her) Hold the door, please. (The door closes on him, and when the other door opens, Doofenshmirtz runs inside) Come on, come on, come on, come on! (Too late, as the pigeons assault the screaming Doofenshmirtz as the door closes)

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Woo-hoo!/Way to go!/Yeah!/Awesome! (While that was happening, Linda pulls in the driveway)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Laughs) We beat ya. You're both big old purple pickled eggs!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You were out of your tree.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, we were first.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nuh-uh, we were.

Name: Candace/Stacy
Dialog: We were.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We were.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Looks like you're having fun.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, Mom, you know what they say. (Candace and Stacy proceed to shoot a water balloon at Phineas)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Fun never falls too far from the tree house. (Gets hit by a water balloon as well)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You see, you see how I held that last note, good, huh?
